plugins.name: prompt-optimizer
plugins.description: /optimize rewrites a draft prompt with repo context and fills it into the composer

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: /handoff records the session as background notes for a fresh session, saved per project under ~/.local/share/handoffs; /handoff resume loads one into a new session without starting any work; open questions of a recap are asked before it is saved

plugins.name: brainstorm
plugins.description: /brainstorm studies the project and brainstorms ideas in the browser, saved under ~/.local/share/brainstorm/<project>/; /brainstorm plan turns picked ideas into a small-step plan; /brainstorm build has small-model subagents implement it and a strong model review it

plugins.name: draft-pr
plugins.description: /draft-pr drafts a pull request in the project's PR template; /draft-pr-review drafts a review as Conventional Comments; each opens an editable page in the browser that posts to GitHub only when you click

plugins.name: adhd-style
plugins.description: ADHD output style: answer first, short chunks, one next step

plugins.name: code-style
plugins.description: Comment and naming rules at session start; hooks block comments, short or vague identifiers, and finishing before a naming review

plugins.name: tdd
plugins.description: Red, green, refactor enforced: the TDD rules at session start; hooks block implementation edits until a failing test run is recorded and block finishing while tests fail

plugins.name: quality-gates
plugins.description: Blocks git commit and push when fallow audit fails, finishing a turn or subagent while lint or fallow audit fails, and finishing a turn that changed code without a verification step

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Bounds tool output and reads, preserves full logs, guards commits, and supports selective delegation to configured cheaper agents while allowing direct bounded work

plugins.name: ui-design
plugins.description: /ui-design new and /ui-design redesign open mockups in the browser, built from the project's own colors, type, spacing and components; redesign asks for the go-ahead before it changes project code; /ui-design audit checks the theme, the components and their consistency; /ui-design apply builds the picked variant of a saved design in project code; /ui-design fix fixes numbered audit findings in project code

plugins.name: project-notes
plugins.description: Claude writes categorised project notes (fact, finding, decision, reference, debugging) as Markdown files under ~/.local/share/project-notes/<project>/<category>/; a debugging note must hold the reasoning, steps, evidence, findings, next steps and a drafted Shortcut ticket; /project-notes organise files existing session notes the same way

plugins.name: tidy-notes
plugins.description: /tidy-notes reformats the Markdown notes in the handoffs, project-notes, small-plans and brainstorm stores so they are consistently formatted without changing their content; a dry run lists what would change and what looks wrong, and /tidy-notes apply writes the changes.

plugins.name: small-plans
plugins.description: /small-plans breaks work into small, self-contained plans a weaker model can implement and review, saved under ~/.local/share/small-plans/<project>/<set>/; the work is what you name, what the conversation leaves, or with handoff what a saved handoff leaves; /small-plans build has small-model agents implement a whole set or one plan while the session reviews and sends back fixes

plugins.name: token-ledger
plugins.description: Records each session's token use (main session and subagents, per model, cache reads and writes, tool result size per tool) under ~/.cache/token-ledger, shows a one-line summary after each turn, prints a report of recent sessions, and suggests /handoff then /clear when the context grows large

plugins.name: ledger-tune
plugins.description: Reads the token-ledger data, recommends changes that cut context, tokens and cost, applies the ones you pick and verifies them against later sessions.
